name: ResearchBench-derived hypothesis verification development slice
sampling_order: SHA256(DOI) ascending after deterministic DOI deduplication
selection_policy: Apply the previously frozen R1-R6 method-independent inclusion rubric.
Require at least one raw ResearchBench negative to disagree with a substantive part of the gold hypothesis.
Do not rewrite gold or negative hypotheses.
Do not inspect pre-cutoff literature, consequence graphs, or verifier outputs for inclusion.
explicit_nonselection_features: quality or depth of a consequence graph
expected advantage of the proposed method
next_steps: Verify exact first-online publication dates and assign cutoffs.
Freeze a pair-level subset if experiments use pairwise rather than full-list ranking.
Only then perform pre-cutoff literature audits and method development.
